transport.title: Metro M1 (Red Line)
transport.description: Stop: Rho Fiera Milano — direct from Duomo/Cadorna in ~30 min

transport.title: Train from Milano Centrale
transport.description: S5/S6 regional train to Rho Fiera (~20 min). Check Trenord app.

transport.title: By Car
transport.description: A8 highway, exit Fiera. Parking areas P1–P8 on site. Arrive early to avoid queues.

transport.title: From Malpensa Airport
transport.description: Malpensa Express train to Cadorna, then M1 to Rho Fiera (~50 min total)

tips: Download the AI Week app for live updates
Bring a portable charger — long days ahead
Comfortable shoes — the venue is very large
Badge required at all times — keep it visible
Water stations available throughout the venue
